meta.description: Compare 13 AI chains for spoken Hausa health questions by answer quality, response time, cost and environmental impact.
meta.og_description: Results for 13 AI chains tested on 30 spoken Hausa questions.

voice.text:
Ina dauke da jarirai biyu. Shin
ina bukatar kulawa ta musamman?
voice.sub:
I'm having twins. Do
I need special care?

board.hint: Blue columns can run in your own country. The dashed line is the 10 s limit for phone calls.
board.note: Cost is the observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charge across 30 benchmark runs per chain, from $40 to $63 per 1,000 questions. EcoCost estimates cover text-model inference only and exclude speech recognition and direct-audio inference; Kimi K3 has no EcoCost result in its run records. Sovereign-deployable: every step can run in your country or on your own servers, using open-weight models or, for Intron, speech recognition on local hardware. Private API: at least one step is only available from its maker’s cloud.

scatter.aria: Gemini 3.1 Pro with direct audio has the highest score; no chain answers within 10 seconds.

score.front: Labelled: the best chain and the best sovereign-deployable one
score.note: Hover a point for a quick look, select it for details. Source: Gooey.AI, Aug 30, 2026.

cost.front: Labelled best trade-offs: no other chain is both cheaper and faster
cost.note: Arithmetic mean of 30 observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charges per chain, normalized to 1,000 questions. Historical benchmark pricing, not a future-price guarantee. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

carbon.front: Labelled best trade-offs among covered chains
carbon.note: EcoCost estimate from 29 to 30 runs per covered chain; low confidence. Speech recognition and direct-audio inference are excluded, and Kimi K3 has no EcoCost result. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

samples_intro: Three of the 30 questions, spoken in Hausa and chosen to show a range of scores. Answers are from Gemini 3.1 Pro listening to the audio directly, each graded against a reference answer.
